name: petko-word-quest
description: Petko Word Quest — Capacitor packaging for Google Play and App Store

scripts.cap:sync: npm run build && npx cap sync
scripts.cap:sync:android: npm run build && npx cap sync android
scripts.cap:sync:ios: npm run build && npx cap sync ios
scripts.android:debug: npm run cap:sync:android && cd android && .\gradlew.bat assembleDebug
scripts.android:bundle: npm run cap:sync:android && cd android && .\gradlew.bat bundleRelease
